decisions.reason: As a consumer superfood product outside the firm's main industrial waste-to-energy and engineering focus, it looks like a weak strategic fit whose uncertain upside is not worth continued commercialization effort.

These modular waste-to-energy extensions fit the firm's core technological capabilities and can be kept as a relatively low-cost option while market demand and deployment opportunities continue to develop.

Because the waste-oil-to-energy plant was presented as a flagship and closely matches the firm's core sustainable industrial platform, management would likely continue backing it rather than abandon the option now.

The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant is strategically central, technologically related to the firm's capabilities, and still valuable as an option in a growing innovation-intensive environment despite remaining uncertainty.
